import json
from collections import defaultdict

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cells=[(i,j,grid[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]]
    for name,key in [("anti",lambda i,j:i+j),("row",lambda i,j:i),("diag",lambda i,j:i-j)]:
        m=defaultdict(set)
        for i,j,v in cells: m[key(i,j)].add(v)
        if not all(len(s)==1 for s in m.values()): continue
        line={k:next(iter(s)) for k,s in m.items()}
        p=len(line); assign={}; bad=False
        for s,v in line.items():
            r=s%p
            if r in assign and assign[r]!=v: bad=True; break
            assign[r]=v
        if bad or len(assign)!=p: continue
        f=lambda i,j: assign[key(i,j)%p]
        return [[f(i,j) for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError

import json
from collections import defaultdict

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cells=[(i,j,grid[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]]
    for name,key in [("anti",lambda i,j:i+j),("row",lambda i,j:i),("diag",lambda i,j:i-j)]:
        m=defaultdict(set)
        for i,j,v in cells: m[key(i,j)].add(v)
        if not all(len(s)==1 for s in m.values()): continue
        line={k:next(iter(s)) for k,s in m.items()}
        p=len(line); assign={}; bad=False
        for s,v in line.items():
            r=s%p
            if r in assign and assign[r]!=v: bad=True; break
            assign[r]=v
        if bad or len(assign)!=p: continue
        f=lambda i,j: assign[key(i,j)%p]
        return [[f(i,j) for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError

def transform(grid):
    """Transform based on diagonal pattern"""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    
    # For input with main diagonal (r-c constant) pattern
    # Color cells by their main diagonal position (r-c)
    anti_diag = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 0:
                key = r - c
                if key not in anti_diag:
                    anti_diag[key] = grid[r][c]
    
    print(f"Anti-diagonal keys: {sorted(anti_diag.keys())}")
    print(f"Anti-diagonal colors: {dict(anti_diag)}")
    
    # Fill output with anti-diagonal colors
    output = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            key = r - c
            color = anti_diag.get(key, 0)
            output[r][c] = color
    
    return output

    task_data = json.load(f)

# Load and test the transform function
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cells=[(i,j,grid[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]]
    for name,key in [("anti",lambda i,j:i+j),("row",lambda i,j:i),("diag",lambda i,j:i-j)]:
        m=defaultdict(set)
        for i,j,v in cells: m[key(i,j)].add(v)
        if not all(len(s)==1 for s in m.values()): continue
        line={k:next(iter(s)) for k,s in m.items()}
        p=len(line); assign={}
        for s,v in line.items():
            r=s%p
            if r in assign and assign[r]!=v: break
            assign[r]=v
        else:
            f=lambda i,j: assign[key(i,j)%p]
            return [[f(i,j) for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
